name: Athens International Airport S.A.
summary: Athens International Airport S.A. engages in the designing, development, financing, construction, commissioning, maintenance, operation, and management of airport in Greece. The company offers baggage, air transport, business lounges, currency exchange banks/ ATMS courier, hospitality, airport information, lost property, car rentals, WiFi, and internet kiosks and mobile services, as well as health and wellness, and family/ kids facilities; and retail-park and exhibition center, and shopping center services for travelers.
